current.text: Projected to start for Orlando next to Jalen Suggs, Franz Wagner, Paolo Banchero and Wendell Carter Jr.
His usage was under 23% last season, even with Franz Wagner out for most of the year.
Expected to be the third option behind Banchero and Wagner, not a primary ball handler. Projected for under 22% usage and about 32 minutes.
Much of his production last season came while Wagner, Banchero and Suggs missed long stretches. His three point attempt rate also dropped.
He started last season badly and then shot 41% from three after December 1.
If Wagner and Banchero stay healthy, he will not come close to last season's value.
Overpriced and a top fade. His ESPN rank of 41 and Yahoo rank of 48 assume long injuries to other Orlando players. Do not take him inside the top 50.
Tier 5 in both the shooting guard and small forward tier rankings.

Experts avoid him in mocks. Josh would not consider him at pick 59, another speaker says he will never roster him, and Josh valued him at about 20 USD in an auction mock but did not want him there. He went for 11 USD in that mock.
Played all 82 games last season, the most of his career. Experts doubt he repeats that.
Orlando has a new head coach, Sean Sweeney. His effect on pace, offense and rotations is unknown, so roles may change.
Orlando's schedule is ordinary: 3-4-4 games (11) in our playoff weeks and 14 back-to-backs.

durable.text: Strong free throw shooter, about 90% on about 4 attempts per game. It is his best category.
No category is clearly weak. He gives steady threes, points and assists with a neutral FG%.
His games played change a lot from year to year.
His defensive stats are not reliable from year to year.

note: Bane went for 22 USD in our auction last season, and Yahoo values him at 22 USD. The experts agree he is a fade, and the real market (Yahoo average cost 9.1 USD, ESPN 13 USD, 11 USD in one auction mock) prices him much lower, so bid only around 10 to 13 USD. He has no weak category, and his 90% FT%, threes and points fit any build as a mid-round piece. Early in the season, check his usage and minutes under the new coach with Wagner and Banchero healthy.
